lead_headline: Aegean and Mediterranean Coasts Protected by Blue Shield
lead_deck: A blue shield application has been introduced in the Aegean and Mediterranean to protect the marine ecosystem.
lead_body: The project, aiming to preserve biological diversity along the coastline, has been implemented in the Aegean and Mediterranean regions.
The application aims to protect underwater habitats and promote sustainable tourism.
